title: Analyzer Auto-Load Configuration
description: Configuration for automatic loading of Roslyn analyzers in MCPsharp, read from .mcpsharp/autoload-config.json in the project root

loadOnStartup.description: Load the analyzers of the project MCPsharp opens at startup as soon as it is loaded, in the background (true), or on first use (false)

analyzerSources.description: Sources to load analyzers from: project_references loads the analyzers the open project's projects reference

excludeAnalyzers.description: Analyzer IDs to exclude from auto-loading

customAnalyzerPaths.description: Custom directories or DLL files to load analyzers from
